phase3-daily-assistant.title: Phase 3: 日常助手
phase3-daily-assistant.description: Scheduled tasks + notification handling + OpenAI OAuth。把 Android Agent 从一次性工具变成每天都用的 assistant。

scheduled-tasks.title: Scheduled Tasks
scheduled-tasks.description: Cron 式定时任务执行。用户设定 schedule + natural language instruction。AlarmManager/WorkManager 触发 → 启动 agent session → 执行 → 记录结果。UI: 任务列表、创建/编辑/删除、执行历史。
acceptCriteria: User can create a scheduled task with cron expression and instruction
Tasks execute on schedule via WorkManager/AlarmManager
Failed tasks show error and can be retried
scheduled-tasks.note: Deferred — not on near-term roadmap. Folder under projects/active/ preserved for design context. Restore via state→ready when picking up.

notification-handling.title: Notification Handling
notification-handling.description: NotificationListenerService 监听 → 按用户定义的规则触发 agent 响应。规则引擎：app filter + keyword filter + sender filter → trigger action。用户 explicit opt-in 每条规则。
acceptCriteria: User can create filter rules (app, keyword, sender)
Matching notifications trigger agent task execution
Each rule requires explicit user opt-in
notification-handling.note: Deferred — not on near-term roadmap. Folder under projects/active/ preserved for design context. Restore via state→ready when picking up.
